prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a flat top-down production GAME FLOOR TEXTURE sheet with 2 equal square cells in a 1024x512 canvas. Both cells fill their square completely, NO magenta, NO background margin, NO borders or text. Left dark variant, right light variant, same material and pattern density. Texture: worn charcoal cracked asphalt, fine gravel, subtle pink/cyan reflected neon, NO large road signs. Neon Trash cartoon, hand-drawn thick dark contour with soft two-tone cel shading, match the environment materials in supplied reference, simplified quieter ground to keep enemies readable. Seamlessly tileable in X and Y in EACH individual square, identical material and feature continuity on all opposite edges, uniform lighting, no vignette, no wall or horizon, no standing props. Do not include throne room.
